text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha... Looks like we've got the whole 
set now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you saw it too, 
Verxina-san? That mock race, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Hehe, it was truly breathtaking. 
That fierce clash between Gentile-san and 
Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the sheer intensity was unreal, sir. 
It was as if neither of them saw anything 
else around them—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: And as if to show it off to us—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haha, looks like we matched again.
